title: Balcony With Lanny
about: Sharing the State Arts-In stage with Lanny, someone I considered my 4-H father.
description: This track remembers the experience of performing alongside Lanny, my 4-H father. We began out of sight on the back stairs, listening to the show through the walls and waiting for our cue, then moved to the balcony before eventually joining the performance below. More than the staging itself, the memory is about getting to share something I loved with someone I considered family.

Lyrics: We could hear the show beginning,
While we waited for our cue.
Then the music called us forward,
And he stepped out there with me.
We made our way up to the balcony,
We weren't there just as spectators,
We both knew our turn would come.
Part of something so much bigger,
To the moment we'd step in.
From the stairs up to the balcony,
We weren't watching from the outside...
We were part of something more.
We left the balcony behind us
And moved to join the song.
Now Lanny stood there with me,
And we became part of the scene.
We started on those back stairs,
But the memory that stayed with me
